name: leduc-astra-expert-actions-vs-public-summary-v1
status: preparing; full collection and training wait for the current Leduc result
scope: Follow-up to the independent LeAct reproduction, not an original paper benchmark

teacher.credential: NVIDIA_INFERENCE_API_KEY or macOS Keychain service egoverse.leact.nvidia-inference
collection_order: Freeze actions and mixed policies for all 4032 information states
Request a public explanation of each frozen decision
teacher.explanation: 1-3 sentences, requested maximum 100 words, validation ceiling 120 words; a public decision summary, not private internal reasoning
teacher.visibility: Game rules, acting player's information state and legal actions only; no CFR policy or opponent private card
teacher.validation: Exact model identity; complete public JSON response; all legal actions; finite probabilities summing to one; no fallback or action repair

arms.procedure: LeAct with Astra expert action policies
arms.student_reasoning: Student generates and filters its own traces
arms.sft: Joint forward/backward SFT on admitted student traces, with frozen Astra policy targets

arms.procedure: Same LeAct procedure with an additional public teacher explanation
arms.backward_hint: Identical qualitative action policy plus Astra's frozen brief explanation
arms.student_reasoning: Student generates and filters its own traces; teacher summary is an extra backward hint
arms.sft: Same joint forward/backward SFT and identical Astra policy targets; forward/evaluation prompts contain no expert hint

matched_settings.initialization: Same immutable shared reasoning anchor used by the current reproduction
matched_settings.selection: Positive forward delta against Astra's policy; all baseline and candidate policies must finish and parse
matched_settings.length_filter: Both SFT examples must fit before admitting a trace; log different admission counts rather than hiding them

evaluation.oracle: Original immutable CFR+ solver, never replaced by Astra for evaluation
evaluation.teacher_baseline: Measure Astra's own full-tree policy exploitability before training
evaluation.epoch_selection: Evaluate every epoch; select by mean oracle-BoN exploitability, matching the current reproduction
evaluation.interpretation: Tests whether revealing a teacher's public explanation helps LeAct. It does not test recovery of private internal reasoning.

dependency.gate: All planned current Leduc rounds complete, with lower mean single and oracle-BoN exploitability than the shared reasoning anchor
dependency.gate_is_not: A claim of matching the paper's numerical results
dependency.preflight_exception: At most four fixed information states for API, formatting and provenance checks; no GPU training

logging: SFT optimizer steps and parameter-change verification

execution.full_teacher_collection: Implemented with the Leduc dependency gate
execution.training_jobs: Not submitted; two current H100 jobs continue
execution.tracker: Local tracker active; ITSS publishing still awaits the existing SSH authentication
